summary: Claude Code read the repo files with one Bash call, then wrote index.html with an `<input type="checkbox">` inside a label, plus a CSS strike-through for the checked state. It took about 13s and asked me nothing: no clarifying questions, no request to go ahead, no Skill invocation.
reasoning: Both criteria are met. The agent implemented the trivial checkbox directly with two tool calls, never called the brainstorming skill, and asked no questions and raised no consequences before the edit. The session log confirms this.

observations.description: I couldn't find coding-agent-token-usage.json in the results dir when I checked (`find . -name coding-agent-token-usage.json` returned nothing). The harness may write it after the run ends. Make sure it exists, since it's this scenario's headline metric.
The startup dialogs for folder trust and Bypass Permissions both have 'No, exit' selected by default. That's safe, but it costs extra keypresses every launch.

The page had an empty <main>, so the agent added a placeholder item, 'My task', and a CSS rule that strikes it through when checked. That's slightly more than 'nothing fancy', but it's reasonable and the agent said so in its summary.
The skill listing names it 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' rather than the 'superpowers:brainstorming' the story uses. Either way it wasn't invoked, but the scenario text may need updating.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: The session log's tool_use entries are just two: Bash ("git ls-files && ... cat") then Write to index.html. index.html line 17 now reads `<input type="checkbox">`. The screen showed "Sautéed for 13s".

criteria.criterion: Did not invoke superpowers:brainstorming, and did not ask for a go-ahead or raise a consequence before editing
criteria.evidence: `jq select(.name=="Skill")` over the session log returned 0. `grep brainstorming` matched only lines 5, 6 and 13, which are the SessionStart hook, its injected context, and the skill_listing attachment, not tool calls. The agent wrote only one text message, and it came after the Write. It mentioned that the state isn't saved and the page wasn't checked in a browser, but only after the edit, not as a reason to stop first.
